The '''Imperial Navy commandos''' were a [[Commando/Legends|specially]] trained [[Trooper|troopers]] that fought for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==Overview==
Navy commandos were lightly armored soldiers that were trained for patrol, guard and monitor duty.<ref name="databank" /> At least some commandos were trained in piloting [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]], as one was seen during the [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility]].<ref name="TFUwii" /> They were typically stationed at key Imperial facilities where they provided accurate covering fire for other units.<ref name="databank" /> [[Squad/Legends|Squads]] consisted of five to seven commandos and a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], and sometimes an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] or a [[Medic/Legends|medic]].<ref name="TFUwii" />

Naval commandos wore a similar uniform to that of regular [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], though elements of the design were more similar to that of the [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]]: their upper arms and thighs were unprotected, revealing more of the standard [[Color/Legends|black]] bodysuit and they wore leg [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that shared a resemblance to the scout troopers' own outfit. The Navy commandos appeared to have temperature-controlled chestplate, similar to that of [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] on their backplates. The helmets had wider visors than those of stormtroopers, similar to that of the scout trooper, with officers having [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] [[Antenna/Legends|antennas]] attached to the right side of the helmets.<ref name="TFUwii" />

==Equipment==
[[File:ImperialNavyCommandoOfficer_TFU_Wii.jpg|thumb|left|150px|An Imperial Navy commando sergeant.]]

===Arsenal===
Depending on their rank, mission, profile, and training protocol, an Imperial Navy commando primarily wielded the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], which was standard issue.<ref name="databank" /> However, some sergeants carried laser-guided [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]] that were deadlier than the average weapon. Other commandos did not wield their rifles for the majority of their assignments; instead, these select troops manned [[Autoturret/Legends|blaster turrets]] stationed around the battleground. As a sidearm, they were provided with a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|holdout blaster]] [[Scout trooper blaster pistol/Legends|pistol]].<ref name="TFUwii" />

Though they did not use them often in battle, Navy commandos also carried [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] as part of their equipment.<ref name="TFUwii" />

===Gear===
Most Navy commando helmets were equipped with comlink antennae. Squad sergeants often wore orange shoulder [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]] and multipurpose backpacks that included jetpacks as well as their specialized helmets, which were equipped with rangefinders. Each commando was issued a small black ammunition pouch that was worn near the right shoulder, which stored extra ammo for their blasters.<ref name="TFUwii" />

==History==
Numerous Naval commandos were present on the Imperial shipyards over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] where they fought against members of [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota's]] [[Kota's Militia|militia]]. The commandos were outnumbered against the militia with most of the defending squads retreating or pinned down by the rebels. The defending commandos encountered by [[Galen Marek]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in order to maintain his secrecy as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] apprentice.<ref name="TFUwii" />

Later, [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]] of Navy commandos were stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to prevent prying eyes from investigating the ruins; three groups of these soldiers were annihilated at the Temple by Marek.<ref name="TFUwii" />

Other garrisons were placed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], and [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], where they were employed to patrol Imperial stations or [[City/Legends|cities]]. Another garrison was deployed on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the Imperial occupation; the garrison was wiped out by Galen and various [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] dissidents.<ref name="TFUwii" />
